summary: Implemented and committed the strict two-stage daemon quiesce and post-quiesce observation redesign. Strict startup now classifies before the ordinary ready path, binds authority/lease/V2 journal before target mutation, performs token-authenticated hashes-only idempotent quiesce through the existing daemon HTTP/shutdown chain, proves exact accepted-ack plus successful LIFO shutdown transcript, rejects nonterminal WAL checkpoints without snapshot/reset, seals the sole post-quiesce receipt, snapshots/restores from that receipt, and resumes setup/recovery crashes through a single hash-chained multi-track journal. Non-strict startup and shutdown behavior remains compatible.

npm run check passed on the final tree: 156 unit files / 1173 tests, 32 integration files / 467 passed with 10 skipped, coverage gate 11/11, plus type/lint/boundary/drift/retired-symbol/ring checks.

npm run build:self passed and the rebuilt dist live-process positive test proved old PID exit, exact ack/shutdown transcript, terminal SQLite checkpoint, receipt/snapshot creation, and fresh replacement identity.

The rebuilt dist live-reader negative test proved checkpoint failure leaves old daemon control files observable and creates neither post-quiesce receipt nor snapshot; no SIGKILL-then-continue path is used.

Manual two-stage self-review checked authority ordering, hashes-only payloads, exact filesystem delta, crash points, protected bindings, non-strict compatibility, repository scope, secret/absolute-path absence, and process cleanup.
risks: Alembic code_guard could not run because the plugin rejects its own injected _meta field with non-retryable unrecognized_keys; repository-native full checks and manual review passed.

The exact successful shutdown transcript is deliberately coupled to the registered LIFO hook labels/order; a future shutdown-hook change must update the transcript contract and its built live-process test.
